amores-perros.quote: A stunner: a fiercely brilliant film of such wrenching impact, nonstop drive and unpredictability that watching it becomes an exhilarating ride.
amores-perros.author: Michael Wilmington

amores-perros.quote: Fierce, loving, and electric, this movie's got bite as well as bark.
amores-perros.author: Lisa Schwarzbaum

amores-perros.quote: An overpowering and original piece of bravura filmmaking that constitutes one of the most breathtaking and impressive directing debuts in years.
amores-perros.author: Desmond Ryan

amores-perros.quote: There's a seething moral core in Amores Perros that uses the canine savagery as an entre to human brutality.
amores-perros.author: Wesley Morris

amores-perros.quote: As fine--hard, soft, approachable--as any in movie history.
amores-perros.author: Richard Schickel

amores-perros.quote: One of the great films of our time, or any other.
amores-perros.author: Joe Morgenstern

amores-perros.quote: Has the feel of an instant classic, a melodrama with an exacting precision and a visceral, propulsive energy.
amores-perros.author: Rene Rodriguez

amores-perros.quote: The most enthralling movie of the year.
amores-perros.author: David Edelstein

amores-perros.quote: The titillating sense of out-of-controlness provoked by the camera is echoed in the film's narrative situations, and you simply, and deliciously, haven't a clue as to what he's going to throw at you next.
amores-perros.author: Peter Brunette

amores-perros.quote: A film of tremendous complexity and depth, a galvanic force that sends the mind reeling.
amores-perros.author: Jean Oppenheimer

amores-perros.quote: It's a truly prodigious piece of work, resembling a career summation far more than a maiden voyage.
amores-perros.author: Peter Rainer

amores-perros.quote: Anguish ranges from gritty and realistic to the tragicomic soap opera found in Pedro Almodovar's films.
amores-perros.author: Desson Thomson

amores-perros.quote: It's a film of high energy, punctuated by rock music and a dark wit, yet it is capable of profound reflection and tragic irony.
amores-perros.author: Kevin Thomas

amores-perros.quote: For those willing to submit to its terrible charms, it may be the single most important debut to come out of the Americas in years.
amores-perros.author: Marc Savlov

amores-perros.quote: The gritty, Oscar-nominated "Traffic" is a limo ride compared with the bloodletting in this year's foreign-film nominee from Mexico.
amores-perros.author: Mike Clark

amores-perros.quote: As bloody as any recent film. But it's shot through with a harsh, stony humor that's invigorating enough to be regarded as a slap back at death.
amores-perros.author: Jay Carr

amores-perros.quote: Amores Perros will be too much for some filmgoers, just as "Pulp Fiction" was and "Santa Sangre" certainly was, but it contains the spark of inspiration.
amores-perros.author: Roger Ebert

amores-perros.quote: A headlong pastiche of lower-depth melodrama and absurd black comedy.
amores-perros.author: Michael Sragow

amores-perros.quote: Strong stuff, compelling drama.
amores-perros.author: Jack Mathews

amores-perros.quote: A feverish, breathtaking tour through Mexico City high and low, an explosive, mosaic-style portrait of our continent's largest city.
amores-perros.author: Andrew O'Hehir

amores-perros.quote: He’s (González Iñárritu) conjured up a dark, brutal vision of urban life that sticks to your skin like soot.
amores-perros.author: David Ansen

amores-perros.quote: A film in which nothing is what it seems, this is the kind of genre touch that Mr. González Iñárritu expands into something far more haunting.
amores-perros.author: A.O. Scott

amores-perros.quote: Though unflinching in its savagery, Amores Perros is always compulsive viewing.
amores-perros.author: Kevin Maynard

amores-perros.quote: Sometimes enticing, frequently savage.
amores-perros.author: David Sterritt

amores-perros.quote: A sophisticated, stylish, fast-moving piece of work.
amores-perros.author: Jonathan Foreman

amores-perros.quote: He (Gonzalez Inarritu) handles a complex plot with clarity and precision while keeping audience members on the edge of their seats.
amores-perros.author: David Stratton

amores-perros.quote: Solidly engaging.
amores-perros.author: Barbara Scharres

amores-perros.quote: There's something overly studied, almost clinical, in how it all pulls together.
amores-perros.author: Manohla Dargis

amores-perros.quote: Often thrilling, if overwhelmingly brutal, trio of interconnected short stories.
amores-perros.author: Ken Fox

amores-perros.quote: Undeniably high-powered. At 153 minutes, it's also punishingly overlong.
amores-perros.author: J. Hoberman

amores-perros.quote: This isn't a cheerful movie. But director Alejandro Gonzalez Iñarritu and writer Guillermo Arriaga tell these stories with authority and verve, making 2½ hours zip by.
amores-perros.author: Lawrence Toppman

21-grams.quote: A stunning kaleidoscope of a motion picture - a mosaic of images that gradually resolves itself into a powerful tale of tragedy and redemption.
21-grams.author: James Berardinelli

21-grams.quote: You won't come out unaffected, because the depths of intimacy that the Mexican director Alejandro González Iñárritu plumbs here are so rarely touched by filmmakers that 21 Grams is tantamount to the discovery of a new country.
21-grams.author: A.O. Scott

21-grams.quote: At the very least, look for it on 10-best lists next month, and there's every chance it will be a strong contender at the Oscars. Filmmaking so sensitive and intelligent deserves its weight in honors.
21-grams.author: David Sterritt

21-grams.quote: Unstintingly explores and exposes excruciating pain, raw grief, ruinous vengeance and life-affirming resilience, creating human portraits that are uncommonly exhilarating in their honesty. This is cinematic art in its highest form.
21-grams.author: Claudia Puig

21-grams.quote: As darkness falls over the movie landscape comes the year's darkest and best movie of them all - Alejandro González Iñárritu's 21 Grams.
21-grams.author: Jack Mathews

21-grams.quote: This sad, staggering drama should be seen: out of the grimness, and the profound calamity, you can almost taste life in your mouth.
21-grams.author: Steven Rea

21-grams.quote: 21 Grams strives for greatness, and that's precisely what it achieves.
21-grams.author: Rob Fraser

21-grams.quote: A stunning virtuoso performance by director, cast and crew. This movie knocks you out with an astonishing blend of hyper-realism, visual complexity and powerful themes.
21-grams.author: Kirk Honeycutt

21-grams.quote: Trust me, if you have a thirst for a good, dark drama, this one is a big gulp.
21-grams.author: D.W. Smith

21-grams.quote: Mr. Penn has been praised lavishly for his work in "Mystic River," in a role that was no reach for him at all, but this is one of the stand-out performances of his career, layered and exquisitely nuanced. And, remarkably, he's only one-third of a stellar ensemble.
21-grams.author: Joe Morgenstern

21-grams.quote: What gives the film a formalist kick is that the story unfolds piecemeal as a series of nonlinear moments. What gives it soul are the three lead actors who pull the pieces together with devastating power.
21-grams.author: Manohla Dargis

21-grams.quote: The movie itself is a miracle: tough, smart, relentless, provocative and, above all, serious.
21-grams.author: Stephen Hunter

21-grams.quote: You won't see more explosive acting this year.
21-grams.author: Peter Travers

21-grams.quote: Stunningly photographed, largely with a hand-held camera, by Rodrigo Prieto (another member of the "Amores Perros" team) on gritty locations in Memphis and Albuquerque, 21 Grams is also a visual tour de force - and a rare Hollywood product depicting class differences with any kind of honesty.
21-grams.author: Lou Lumenick

21-grams.quote: Blessed with one of the strongest casts of any American movie this year, this bravura film, with its radical structure, is full of risk and reward.
21-grams.author: Michael Wilmington

21-grams.quote: One of the most original, and certainly among the best-acted films this year, 21 Grams focuses on people on the verge of dying, having survived death or grasping at the slender threads of new lives.
21-grams.author: Liam Lacey

21-grams.quote: Paradoxically, a movie that loses power the more you perceive what's actually going on in it. Laid end to end, the story is, to put it mildly, overwrought, fusing several cataclysms too many.
21-grams.author: Owen Gleiberman

21-grams.quote: A punch in the stomach of a movie. It is as ugly as it is beautiful, as full of peaks as of lows. It's a character-driven movie about people on an emotional edge who are ridding themselves of the things that can no longer work without inflicting damage.
21-grams.author: Sean Axmaker

21-grams.quote: A nearly unparalleled actor's showcase, the film boasts performances of impressive quality and quantity...Their complexity matches the film's.
21-grams.author: Nathan Rabin

21-grams.quote: Each and every one of the movie's 125 minutes is a moment of searing truth.
21-grams.author: Rick Kisonak

21-grams.quote: A devastating and weighty picture.
21-grams.author: Kimberley Jones

21-grams.quote: 21 Grams tells such a tormenting story that it just about survives its style. It would have been more powerful in chronological order, and even as a puzzle, it has a deep effect.
21-grams.author: Roger Ebert

21-grams.quote: The payoff in 21 Grams comes not from watching characters achieve or overcome but from the recognition of their struggle not to give up the fight.
21-grams.author: Carla Meyer

21-grams.quote: Despite juggled storytelling, the movie's compelling.
21-grams.author: Lawrence Toppman

21-grams.quote: Watts, who has the most difficult scenes, is splendidly mercurial; what's surprising is that those professional storm clouds Penn and Del Toro are here as powerfully restrained as she is electrifying.
21-grams.author: J. Hoberman

21-grams.quote: Uprooted from their home soil, González Iñárritu and screenwriter Guillermo Arriaga can't quite manage to make this gloomy, improbable stew of romance, film noir and pseudo-metaphysical speculation hang together.
21-grams.author: Andrew O'Hehir

21-grams.quote: Aside from a little eleventh-hour pseudo-mysticism about death and the weight of the soul, the story is really little more than a unusually gripping thriller.
21-grams.author: Ken Fox

21-grams.quote: As in "Amores perros," Iñarritu and Arriaga slice and dice the chronology, which helps distract from the warmed-over story elements and focus attention on the superior performances.
21-grams.author: J.R. Jones

21-grams.quote: Aimed at the brain, when it should have been one for the heart.
21-grams.author: Robert Wilonsky

21-grams.quote: While a splendidly acted and worthily grown-up movie, too often has the feel of a potboiling soap opera, with twists and turns that range from the grimly ironic to the absurdly sensational.
21-grams.author: Shawn Levy

21-grams.quote: The fragmented style is distracting and ultimately annoying, robbing the story of its suspense and drive while contributing nothing except self-conscious style.
21-grams.author: Rene Rodriguez

21-grams.quote: Ambitiously structured in non-chronological fragments that form a fascinating puzzle, this raw drama about grief, guilt and redemption becomes ultimately overextended and overwrought in its final stretch.
21-grams.author: David Rooney

21-grams.quote: What keeps this movie honest is the characters, each of them a mass of conflicting instincts, virtues and vices. You know Gonzalez Inarritu comes from outside Hollywood because he doesn't divide the world into heroes and villains.
21-grams.author: David Ansen

21-grams.quote: Too-laborious meditation on life and death.
21-grams.author: Glenn Kenny

21-grams.quote: Long on mood and moodiness, but at a loss as how to break any interesting human ground.
21-grams.author: Wesley Morris

21-grams.quote: Luckily, Penn, Watts and Leo carry more weight than that; they keep this movie's two hours and five minutes from seeming like lost time.
21-grams.author: Michael Sragow

21-grams.quote: It’s forceful, to be sure, but in a lurid way that suggests a telenovela that’s been baking in the sun too long.
21-grams.author: Peter Rainer

21-grams.quote: The kind of bad movie that makes a reviewer feel terrible. It has been put together with great sincerity, and yet, impassioned and affecting as some of it is, 21 Grams is also an arrogant failure.  [24 November 2003, p. 113]
21-grams.author: David Denby

21-grams.quote: Where "Amores Perros" was a feast of energy, wit and imagination, 21 Grams is like a starvation diet -- a movie that wallows so profoundly in its own misery that watching it is like atoning for some sin you didn't commit.
21-grams.author: Scott Foundas

21-grams.quote: As usual with Penn, I don't completely buy the character, but I completely buy that he has brilliantly internalized SOMETHING. He goes to some weird psychological places, our Sean.
21-grams.author: David Edelstein

21-grams.quote: It's so laden with foreboding, you want to get out from under it and gasp for air.
21-grams.author: Desson Thomson

babel.quote: In the year's richest, most complex and ultimately most heartbreaking film, Inarritu invites us to get past the babble of modern civilization and start listening to each other.
babel.author: Peter Travers

babel.quote: This is a serious movie overflowing with memorable acting, unforgettable images, searing tragedy, unexpected humor and an eloquent plea for international understanding. And while it's by no stretch of imagination light entertainment, it's fundamentally a more optimistic work than either "Amores Perros" or "21 Grams."
babel.author: Lou Lumenick

babel.quote: Effectively building dread and emotional tension as tragic incidents triggered by human stupidity and carelessness steadily multiply, this film, like "21 Grams" in particular, employs a deterministically grim mindset in the cause of its philosophical aspirations, but is gripping nearly all the way.
babel.author: Todd McCarthy

babel.quote: The filmmakers succeed brilliantly in weaving these stories together, taking time to explore depth of character and relationships. The suspense builds throughout as everyone involved becomes lost in a place they don't understand with people they don't know if they can trust.
babel.author: Ray Bennett

babel.quote: It's a masterful film, the kind you itch to see twice or more, as elliptical as a dream and as direct as the short sharp shock of lead kissing flesh.
babel.author: Marc Savlov

babel.quote: Its complex (yet not mystifying) storytelling, forceful character development, and superb cinematography make this a candidate for one of 2006's best offerings.
babel.author: James Berardinelli

babel.quote: Babel may be the most ambitious movie of the year, tackling towering communication barriers, global politics and cultural divides in a structurally complex and fascinating narrative.
babel.author: Claudia Puig

babel.quote: A powerful movie that should win all the year's ensemble acting awards. Pitt has never done better dramatic work, Blanchett is as convincing as always, and - in introducing themselves to American audiences - veteran Mexican actress Barraza and Japan's Kikuchi are revelations.
babel.author: Jack Mathews

babel.quote: It's a powerhouse, demanding film that sometimes stretches the limits of credibility. But it's done with such consistent technical brilliance--and with such a first-rate cast and company.
babel.author: Michael Wilmington

babel.quote: Even as Inarritu has matured as a craftsman, he has stood perhaps one beat too long in the same place as a storyteller. In ways, Babel is his best work, but it's time to move on.
babel.author: Shawn Levy

babel.quote: Babel is a movie that leaves you feeling limp and wrung out, but mysteriously moved by its vivid human encounters with the hot, tightly wired, chancy and coincidental world, ever capable of terrorizing us when we least expect it.
babel.author: Richard Schickel

babel.quote: The beauty of this film is in its lapidary details, which sparkle with feeling and surprise.
babel.author: Carina Chocano

babel.quote: In the end Babel, like that tower in the book of Genesis, is a grand wreck, an incomplete monument to its own limitless ambition. But it is there, on the landscape, a startling and imposing reality. It's a folly, and also, perversely, a wonder.
babel.author: A.O. Scott

babel.quote: Babel has great expectations for itself: It wants to be a movie about big ideas and big emotions at the same time. Aided by gorgeous locations and classy trappings (cinematography by Rodrigo Prieto, theme music by Gustavo Santaolalla), it succeeds for the most part.
babel.author: Dana Stevens

babel.quote: It may be too slow for some tastes, but Babel remains emotionally bruising but compulsive viewing.
babel.author: Ian Freer

babel.quote: The flashy spectacle of intersecting narratives and its crosscutting and fractured chronology nearly overwhelms the film's simple message, in this case that despite divisions of language, race and geography, we're all connected.
babel.author: Maitland McDonagh

babel.quote: While you can never completely put the fact that you are watching Pitt and Blanchett out of your mind, they both give charged, emotional performances.
babel.author: Jessica Letkemann

babel.quote: It offers razor-sharp editing, first-rate performances, direction that yields maximum emotional effect and a flabby, unconvincing screenplay.
babel.author: Lawrence Toppman

babel.quote: Though Babel lacks any tragic sense of inevitability, it almost compensates with a handful of vibrant performances and the palpable physical texture of the settings.
babel.author: Liam Lacey

babel.quote: The movie doesn't quite achieve the transcendent effect it reaches for, saddled with an ending that fails to live up to our expectations. But the experience of watching Babel is undeniably riveting: Even if the film doesn't really lead anywhere, you still can't take your eyes off it.
babel.author: Rene Rodriguez

babel.quote: Repeatedly, Iñárritu and Arriaga stop themselves just short of suggesting that we're all going to hell in a hand basket. Had they not -- well, then Babel might really have been onto something.
babel.author: Scott Foundas

babel.quote: I hate to criticize anybody for artistic ambition, but the problem with Babel isn't that it's a bad movie. It's a good movie, or, more accurately, it's several pieces of good movie, chopped up in service of a pretentious, portentous and slightly silly artistic vision.
babel.author: Andrew O'Hehir

babel.quote: The film is technically superior, and its look and the strength of its performances (Blanchett, Barraza, and Kikuchi especially) carry it above similar fare.
babel.author: Pete Vonder Haar

babel.quote: Measured in anything other than biblical cubits, the sum of Babel's many parts turns out to be a picture that suggests Americans ought to stay home and treat their nannies better.
babel.author: Lisa Schwarzbaum

babel.quote: Messrs. Iñárritu and Arriaga have played this card one too many times. If they really want to appear radical the next time out, my advice is: Tell a single story and tell it well. What a concept.
babel.author: Peter Rainer

babel.quote: When the best part of the movie is when no one's talking and the anguish relents, it says something. It says that Iñárritu is a great director in need of a screenwriter who has more than one card to play.
babel.author: Noel Murray

babel.quote: All told, the movie also is a tremendous downer. The script goes for a vaguely upbeat conclusion, but it has no spiritual dimension that the viewer feels with any emotion, and it conveys a hopeless, pessimistic future for the interconnected world that it portrays.
babel.author: William Arnold

babel.quote: Comes across as more willfully clever than profound, leaving us to applaud the message while pondering why the messenger had to strain so hard to get it across.
babel.author: Chris Kaltenbach

babel.quote: I was shaken, but not stirred, by Babel, a globalist melodrama that careens from Morocco to Mexico like a revved-up "Crash."
babel.author: Carrie Rickey

babel.quote: Babel is a ziggurat of brilliant pieces built on sand. It's also this season's "Crash," a movie you know is Important because it never stops telling you so.
babel.author: Ty Burr

babel.quote: In their last collaboration, "21 Grams," the director Alejandro González Iñárritu and screenwriter Guillermo Arriaga did syntactical acrobatics to disguise what a dreary and exploitive little soap opera they’d made. Their new movie, Babel, is more mysterious and less coherent.
babel.author: David Edelstein

babel.quote: Babel is an infuriatingly well-made disaster.
babel.author: David Denby

babel.quote: I might buy Babel if it had any real interest in its characters, but it's too busy moving them around its mechanistic chessboard to explore any nuances or depths.
babel.author: David Ansen

babel.quote: Unlike many colleagues, I'm not a fan of "Amores Perros" or "21 Grams," scripted by Guillermo Arriaga and directed by Alejandro Gonzalez Iñarritu. This conclusion to their trilogy is easier to follow as a narrative, but it's even more pretentious, generalizing about the state of the modern world.
babel.author: Jonathan Rosenbaum

babel.quote: It's a film of unquestioned visual artistry, and the filmmakers' empathy and human understanding are apparent moment to moment, scene by scene. But despite sensitive performances, it's an experiment that fizzles.
babel.author: Mick LaSalle

babel.quote: Puzzle master Arriaga may be the Will Shortz of globalized hand-wringing, but the by-now-predictable jigsawing of his scripts reeks of desperation.
babel.author: Jim Ridley

babel.quote: The ultimate poor judgment: the decision to put Babel before the camera. That defies comprehension in any language.
babel.author: Joanne Kaufman

babel.quote: Yet as sophisticated a piece of filmmaking as it is, it seems hamstrung by the banality at its center; that's why it never assembles into a satisfying whole. It's pretty -- oh, what's the word? -- stupid in its dramatization of the silly little connections that unite us, and it's somewhat selective in its choice of them.
babel.author: Stephen Hunter

biutiful.quote: Biutiful, which gets it name from a child's misspelling of the word, is in itself a beautiful, mesmerizing film and Iñárritu's masterpiece.
biutiful.author: Pete Hammond

biutiful.quote: Biutiful has a strong, linear narrative drive. Nevertheless, and most of all, it's a gorgeous, melancholy tone poem about love, fatherhood and guilt.
biutiful.author: Kirk Honeycutt

biutiful.quote: Bardem's soulful turn lends this haunting meditation a sense of hope and saves it from the contrived missteps it teeters toward.
biutiful.author: Claudia Puig

biutiful.quote: Biutiful is strong stuff, it will leave you shaken. There's poetry here, and catastrophe.
biutiful.author: Steven Rea

biutiful.quote: Iñárritu has made a modern classical tragedy and, in Javier Bardem, he has found his first authentic hero; a character caught up in an intricate web of events he cannot extricate himself from.
biutiful.author: Andrew Male

biutiful.quote: It's Bardem's portrayal of his search for those answers that drives Biutiful forward.
biutiful.author: Bill Goodykoontz

biutiful.quote: As much as Bardem is an expressive instrument for parlaying Iñárritu's somber worldview, so too is cinematographer Rodrigo Prieto, whose stunning compositions find the poetry amid the sorrow.
biutiful.author: Marjorie Baumgarten

biutiful.quote: Shot hand-held with a poet's eye by Rodrigo Prieto, the film is relentless but as riveting as the world a remarkable actor lets us see through Uxbal's eyes. Bravo, Bardem.
biutiful.author: Peter Travers

biutiful.quote: Set on the seamy side of Barcelona, Biutiful may not be a feel-good movie for this time of year, but it's well worth your time.
biutiful.author: V.A. Musetto

biutiful.quote: Surely few actors have faces that project sorrow more completely than Bardem.
biutiful.author: Roger Ebert

biutiful.quote: Biutiful exists, at its best and beautifully, in that space that's hard to define, between the outside and the interior, action and thought, body and soul.
biutiful.author: Mick LaSalle

biutiful.quote: Biutiful soars to its highest points once it shifts its focus away from death to ask us how we are choosing to live our lives.
biutiful.author: Sean O'Connell

biutiful.quote: In this vast balloon of a film, Bardem is the ballast – that Manichean face is a movie onto itself.
biutiful.author: Rick Groen

biutiful.quote: The hardest movies to review are the ones you respect and admire but don't love and also - and this is the crucial part - aren't angered by. Director Alejandro Gonzalez Inarritu's Biutiful is just that sort of film.
biutiful.author: Mary Pols

biutiful.quote: Nothing says "Awards Season" like feel-bad cinema, and with Biutiful, Iñárritu hauls out the big guns. He also, maddeningly, has one hell of a weapon in his star, Javier Bardem.
biutiful.author: Stephanie Zacharek

biutiful.quote: Yet another, albeit sparer, Iñárritu gloom-fest.
biutiful.author: Shawn Levy

biutiful.quote: The movie is unwieldy and overstuffed with subplots - and, at 2 1/2 hours, probably too much misery and sorrow for most viewers.
biutiful.author: Rene Rodriguez

biutiful.quote: The movie wails in pain. And it's that sort of grand empathy that makes Iñárritu both impossible to dismiss and impossible to live with.
biutiful.author: Wesley Morris

biutiful.quote: The saving grace of Biutiful is Bardem.
biutiful.author: Joe Williams

biutiful.quote: Sometimes it seems as if Iñárritu is literally carving out his actor's heart, so tangible does Bardem make Uxbal's fears. Iñárritu has so much that he wants to say - too much, in fact, and the film's central weakness - that he has created an emotional tsunami for both the actors and the audience.
biutiful.author: Betsy Sharkey

biutiful.quote: Here, it's all Bardem, and this great actor's careworn face and sensitive presence counts for a lot. He ultimately can't save the soul of Biutiful, but he makes the journey easier.
biutiful.author: Joe Neumaier

biutiful.quote: Mr. Bardem, best known to American audiences for his chillingly persuasive embodiment of evil in "No Country for Old Men," combines muscular, charismatic physicality with an almost delicate sensitivity, and this blend of the rough and the tender gives Biutiful a measure of emotional credibility that it may not entirely deserve.
biutiful.author: A.O. Scott

biutiful.quote: It's a one-note character that Bardem builds into a complex emotional chord, lessening the urge to dismiss Biutiful solely as an endurance test for viewers.
biutiful.author: Steve Persall

biutiful.quote: However much Uxbal tries to help Barcelona's dispossessed, Biutiful doesn't really have anything to say about the modern world's economic migrants. Indeed, it could even be said that the movie exploits them.
biutiful.author: Mark Jenkins

biutiful.quote: The safe course is to recommend the film, which seems pitilessly long at 147 minutes, only for the transcendent quality of Javier Bardem's performance.
biutiful.author: Joe Morgenstern

biutiful.quote: Cinematographer Rodrigo Pietro grounds the ghostly encounters in grainy imagery, his unobtrusive handheld camera and deeply saturated colors best appreciated in a nightclub sequence that looks like something from Hieronymous Bosch.
biutiful.author: Andrea Gronvall

biutiful.quote: For many, this central performance will be more than enough. For others, the film will simply be too much.
biutiful.author: Michael Phillips

biutiful.quote: Iñárritu does the actor no favors by putting him through the existential wringer every step of the way. Uxbal suffers for all our sins.
biutiful.author: Peter Rainer

biutiful.quote: It is raw, it is searing, it is honest.
biutiful.author: Mike Scott

biutiful.quote: In spite of fine work from Bardem and Álvarez, Biutiful is an irritating, oppressive 150-minute dirge, not the step forward Iñárritu's dissolved partnership with Arriaga seemed to promise.
biutiful.author: Scott Tobias

biutiful.quote: This forced march through a chamber of personal and sociological horrors is difficult to endure but easy to forget.
biutiful.author: Dana Stevens

biutiful.quote: We've come to expect diminishing returns from the once-promising Mexican director who then gave the world "Babel," but the combination of wallowing humanistic-cinema overkill and outright ridiculousness he lays out here represents a new low. Biutiful is not a tragedy. It's a straight-up travesty.
biutiful.author: David Fear

biutiful.quote: Though its structure may be whittled down in comparison with the earlier works, Biutiful is even more morbidly obese than "Babel" in terms of soggy ideas, elephantine with miserabilist humanism and redemption jibber-jabber.
biutiful.author: Melissa Anderson

birdman-or-the-unexpected-virtue-of-igno.quote: Spectacular, star-powered cinema that makes us ask anew what cinema is for. Call it a "Dark Knight" of the soul.
birdman-or-the-unexpected-virtue-of-igno.author: Robbie Collin

reviewedProduct.title: Birdman or (The Unexpected Virtue of Ignorance)

birdman-or-the-unexpected-virtue-of-igno.quote: Birdman is a rich, startlingly clever and multi-layered collage, with Iñárritu creating a meta-universe of mirrors and performances upon performances.
birdman-or-the-unexpected-virtue-of-igno.author: John Bleasdale

reviewedProduct.title: Birdman or (The Unexpected Virtue of Ignorance)

birdman-or-the-unexpected-virtue-of-igno.quote: The film's exhilarating originality, black comedy and tone that is at once empathetic and acidic will surely strike a strong chord with audiences looking for something fresh that will take them somewhere they haven't been before.
birdman-or-the-unexpected-virtue-of-igno.author: Todd McCarthy

reviewedProduct.title: Birdman or (The Unexpected Virtue of Ignorance)

birdman-or-the-unexpected-virtue-of-igno.quote: It’s borderline miraculous.
birdman-or-the-unexpected-virtue-of-igno.author: Jessica Kiang

reviewedProduct.title: Birdman or (The Unexpected Virtue of Ignorance)

birdman-or-the-unexpected-virtue-of-igno.quote: It's dazzling and rambling, intimate and sprawling, and it's carried along by an infectious, off-the-cuff jazz score. As soon as it ends, you'll be dying to fly with it again.
birdman-or-the-unexpected-virtue-of-igno.author: Cath Clarke

reviewedProduct.title: Birdman or (The Unexpected Virtue of Ignorance)

birdman-or-the-unexpected-virtue-of-igno.quote: A triumph on every creative level, from casting to execution.
birdman-or-the-unexpected-virtue-of-igno.author: Peter Debruge

reviewedProduct.title: Birdman or (The Unexpected Virtue of Ignorance)

birdman-or-the-unexpected-virtue-of-igno.quote: Serious and silly, self-aware and ironic, it’s the movie that questions stardom, fame and celebrity, built around a role Michael Keaton had to become a has-been to play.
birdman-or-the-unexpected-virtue-of-igno.author: Roger Moore

reviewedProduct.title: Birdman or (The Unexpected Virtue of Ignorance)

birdman-or-the-unexpected-virtue-of-igno.quote: I'm jazzed by every tasty, daring, devastating, howlingly funny, how'd-they-do-that minute in Birdman. Like all movies that soar above the toxic clouds of Hollywood formula and defy death at the box office, Alejandro G. Iñárritu's cinematic whirlwind will bring out the haters. They can all go piss off. Birdman is a volcano of creative ideas in full eruption. Buy a ticket and brace yourself.
birdman-or-the-unexpected-virtue-of-igno.author: Peter Travers

reviewedProduct.title: Birdman or (The Unexpected Virtue of Ignorance)

birdman-or-the-unexpected-virtue-of-igno.quote: The camerawork in Birdman is an astonishment, and an argument that everything flows together, which in this movie means the cinematography, the story, the people, even time and space.
birdman-or-the-unexpected-virtue-of-igno.author: Manohla Dargis

reviewedProduct.title: Birdman or (The Unexpected Virtue of Ignorance)

birdman-or-the-unexpected-virtue-of-igno.quote: This pitch-dark comedy, which was directed, con brio, by Alejandro G. Iñárritu, sizzles as the camera circles, stalks and swoops. Emmanuel Lubezki’s friction-free cinematography constitutes a virtuoso turn in its own right in a production that’s strewn with superb performances, some of them loud and bold, others subtle and restrained.
birdman-or-the-unexpected-virtue-of-igno.author: Joe Morgenstern

reviewedProduct.title: Birdman or (The Unexpected Virtue of Ignorance)

birdman-or-the-unexpected-virtue-of-igno.quote: The director's surrealist portrait of modern times and the cult of celebrity is brilliant on so many levels that even the occasional downdraft can't keep Birdman from soaring.
birdman-or-the-unexpected-virtue-of-igno.author: Betsy Sharkey

reviewedProduct.title: Birdman or (The Unexpected Virtue of Ignorance)

birdman-or-the-unexpected-virtue-of-igno.quote: With its improvisatory score (drummer Antonio Sanchez provides a hustling backbeat throughout), its seamless shots, its leaps into the surreal, and then back again into the excruciating, embarrassing real, Birdman ascends to the greatest of heights.
birdman-or-the-unexpected-virtue-of-igno.author: Steven Rea

reviewedProduct.title: Birdman or (The Unexpected Virtue of Ignorance)

birdman-or-the-unexpected-virtue-of-igno.quote: Birdman is a complete blast from start to finish.
birdman-or-the-unexpected-virtue-of-igno.author: Christy Lemire

reviewedProduct.title: Birdman or (The Unexpected Virtue of Ignorance)

birdman-or-the-unexpected-virtue-of-igno.quote: The film is so soaring, sometimes literally, I hardly missed the feeling of hard ground underfoot.
birdman-or-the-unexpected-virtue-of-igno.author: Kimberley Jones

reviewedProduct.title: Birdman or (The Unexpected Virtue of Ignorance)

birdman-or-the-unexpected-virtue-of-igno.quote: This is a strange and beautiful and unique film, one of the best movies of the year.
birdman-or-the-unexpected-virtue-of-igno.author: Richard Roeper

reviewedProduct.title: Birdman or (The Unexpected Virtue of Ignorance)

birdman-or-the-unexpected-virtue-of-igno.quote: Birdman is a treat. But it's also more than that. It's a full-fledged wonder.
birdman-or-the-unexpected-virtue-of-igno.author: Bill Goodykoontz

reviewedProduct.title: Birdman or (The Unexpected Virtue of Ignorance)

birdman-or-the-unexpected-virtue-of-igno.quote: The bravura gestures work gorgeously in Birdman, as does the humor, which playfully balances the film’s most mystical, contemplative ideas with a steady stream of inside jokes and well-calibrated shifts in tone and dynamics.
birdman-or-the-unexpected-virtue-of-igno.author: Ann Hornaday

reviewedProduct.title: Birdman or (The Unexpected Virtue of Ignorance)

birdman-or-the-unexpected-virtue-of-igno.quote: This is a remarkable feat, not only of cinematography, but of choreography. Just to film Michael Keaton and Edward Norton walking down a Manhattan street, everything had to be timed as in a dance — when the camera swirls ahead, when it goes behind, when it swoops back around. It’s all accomplished so smoothly that it would be worth doing merely as a stunt, except this is no stunt. This method carries the mood and soul of one of the best movies of 2014.
birdman-or-the-unexpected-virtue-of-igno.author: Mick LaSalle

reviewedProduct.title: Birdman or (The Unexpected Virtue of Ignorance)

birdman-or-the-unexpected-virtue-of-igno.quote: Lots of films claim to be different. Birdman is.
birdman-or-the-unexpected-virtue-of-igno.author: Calvin Wilson

reviewedProduct.title: Birdman or (The Unexpected Virtue of Ignorance)

birdman-or-the-unexpected-virtue-of-igno.quote: Birdman finds Iñárritu in the mood for play, and with a mighty cast that fields every pitch he throws.
birdman-or-the-unexpected-virtue-of-igno.author: Ty Burr

reviewedProduct.title: Birdman or (The Unexpected Virtue of Ignorance)

birdman-or-the-unexpected-virtue-of-igno.quote: The thrilling cinematic joyride that, among other improbable feats, puts Michael Keaton, as Thomson, smack in the middle of the Oscar race for best actor.
birdman-or-the-unexpected-virtue-of-igno.author: Marc Mohan

reviewedProduct.title: Birdman or (The Unexpected Virtue of Ignorance)

birdman-or-the-unexpected-virtue-of-igno.quote: From the first line of its deep, rapid-fire dialog all the way through to its trippy ending -- which is guaranteed prompt discussion on the drive home -- Inarritu has crafted a film that begs to be rewatched, with the promise of each repeated viewing bringing something new.
birdman-or-the-unexpected-virtue-of-igno.author: Mike Scott

reviewedProduct.title: Birdman or (The Unexpected Virtue of Ignorance)

birdman-or-the-unexpected-virtue-of-igno.quote: Everything about Birdman is a bold cinematic stretch, from its snare-jazz soundtrack to a climax regrettably stretched too far. The line between Iñárritu's genius and Riggan's madness gets crossed once too many, but no matter. Birdman has 99 virtues and ignorance isn't one.
birdman-or-the-unexpected-virtue-of-igno.author: Steve Persall

reviewedProduct.title: Birdman or (The Unexpected Virtue of Ignorance)

birdman-or-the-unexpected-virtue-of-igno.quote: Birdman is everything you want movies to be: vital, challenging, intellectually alive, visually stunning, emotionally affecting. And welcome back to the big time, Mr. Keaton; you have been sorely missed.
birdman-or-the-unexpected-virtue-of-igno.author: Ian Freer

reviewedProduct.title: Birdman or (The Unexpected Virtue of Ignorance)

birdman-or-the-unexpected-virtue-of-igno.quote: Iñárritu ditches time-hopping bleakness for a linear, if loopy, satire that buzzes with brio. If Mel Brooks, John Cassavetes and Terry Zwigoff co-directed a superhero movie, this might be it.
birdman-or-the-unexpected-virtue-of-igno.author: Jamie Graham

reviewedProduct.title: Birdman or (The Unexpected Virtue of Ignorance)

birdman-or-the-unexpected-virtue-of-igno.quote: Birdman is a delicious and delirious pleasure.
birdman-or-the-unexpected-virtue-of-igno.author: Peter Bradshaw

reviewedProduct.title: Birdman or (The Unexpected Virtue of Ignorance)

birdman-or-the-unexpected-virtue-of-igno.quote: A magnificent and enthralling film that fits into no easy genre bracket, Birdman or (The Unexpected Virtue Of Ignorance) – to give it its full title – is a technical tour de force, a beautifully performed and smartly scripted black comedy that will leave its audience keen to head back for more.
birdman-or-the-unexpected-virtue-of-igno.author: Mark Adams

reviewedProduct.title: Birdman or (The Unexpected Virtue of Ignorance)

birdman-or-the-unexpected-virtue-of-igno.quote: Watching Alejandro Gonzalez Iñárritu’s multilayered “Birdman” is like unfolding a piece of intricate origami; it keeps opening in unexpected directions.
birdman-or-the-unexpected-virtue-of-igno.author: Moira Macdonald

reviewedProduct.title: Birdman or (The Unexpected Virtue of Ignorance)

birdman-or-the-unexpected-virtue-of-igno.quote: Led by a fantastic Michael Keaton, Birdman is a deeply thoughtful and darkly hilarious meta dissection of egotism that satirizes the entertainment business with a compelling visual style that is all its own.
birdman-or-the-unexpected-virtue-of-igno.author: Zachary Shevich

reviewedProduct.title: Birdman or (The Unexpected Virtue of Ignorance)

birdman-or-the-unexpected-virtue-of-igno.quote: Birdman dares to be ambiguous, but unlike most essays in ambiguity, it is also a hell of a lot of fun.
birdman-or-the-unexpected-virtue-of-igno.author: Catherine Bray

reviewedProduct.title: Birdman or (The Unexpected Virtue of Ignorance)

birdman-or-the-unexpected-virtue-of-igno.quote: Moment to moment, Birdman manages to shift gears, its roaming camera revealing new surprises as it glides along. That degree of unpredictability provides it with the ultimate response to the sea of formulaic mediocrities at the center of its critique.
birdman-or-the-unexpected-virtue-of-igno.author: Eric Kohn

reviewedProduct.title: Birdman or (The Unexpected Virtue of Ignorance)

birdman-or-the-unexpected-virtue-of-igno.quote: Birdman is a scalpel-sharp dissection of Hollywood, Broadway, and fame in the 21st century. But more than that, it's a testament to Keaton's enduring charisma and power as an actor. He soars.
birdman-or-the-unexpected-virtue-of-igno.author: Chris Nashawaty

reviewedProduct.title: Birdman or (The Unexpected Virtue of Ignorance)

birdman-or-the-unexpected-virtue-of-igno.quote: The director has wisely assembled an ensemble of performers who know how to handle a long take; this will certainly rank among Keaton's career highlights — in a role that allows him to completely dump out his paintbox and show a vast range of emotion — but everyone shines.
birdman-or-the-unexpected-virtue-of-igno.author: Alonso Duralde

reviewedProduct.title: Birdman or (The Unexpected Virtue of Ignorance)

birdman-or-the-unexpected-virtue-of-igno.quote: Birdman, right now, is on the money. In Riggan and the rest of the cast, writhing with the dread of being a nobody but appalled by what it takes to be a somebody, we see not just the acting bug but also the New York bug, the love bug, and, if we’re honest, the life bug, diagnosed as what they are: a seventy-year itch.
birdman-or-the-unexpected-virtue-of-igno.author: Anthony Lane

reviewedProduct.title: Birdman or (The Unexpected Virtue of Ignorance)

birdman-or-the-unexpected-virtue-of-igno.quote: Doing a whole movie this way isn't unprecedented, of course. Hitchcock's "Rope" did it without digital trickery more than half a century ago. Still, it's a great cinematic stunt, even when you think you've found the hidden edits. And it makes Birdman as exhilarating a flight of fantasy as you're likely to see anytime soon.
birdman-or-the-unexpected-virtue-of-igno.author: Bob Mondello

reviewedProduct.title: Birdman or (The Unexpected Virtue of Ignorance)

birdman-or-the-unexpected-virtue-of-igno.quote: The picture is a stylistically fearless rush; surreal one moment, satirical the next but never for a second dull, showy or overreaching.
birdman-or-the-unexpected-virtue-of-igno.author: Staff (Not Credited)

reviewedProduct.title: Birdman or (The Unexpected Virtue of Ignorance)

birdman-or-the-unexpected-virtue-of-igno.quote: Shot in 30 days after a long rehearsal period, with the actors’ and the camera’s movements calibrated to the inch and the millisecond so the action flows smoothly, the picture has the jagged energy of a long guerrilla raid choreographed by Bob Fosse.
birdman-or-the-unexpected-virtue-of-igno.author: Richard Corliss

reviewedProduct.title: Birdman or (The Unexpected Virtue of Ignorance)

birdman-or-the-unexpected-virtue-of-igno.quote: Above all else, Birdman is tender, raucously funny and deeply tragic.
birdman-or-the-unexpected-virtue-of-igno.author: Andrew Crump

reviewedProduct.title: Birdman or (The Unexpected Virtue of Ignorance)

birdman-or-the-unexpected-virtue-of-igno.quote: It’s perhaps the most incisive and funniest Hollywood take on Broadway since Mel Brook’s original “The Producers.”
birdman-or-the-unexpected-virtue-of-igno.author: Lou Lumenick

reviewedProduct.title: Birdman or (The Unexpected Virtue of Ignorance)

birdman-or-the-unexpected-virtue-of-igno.quote: One of the year's most audacious, savagely funny and unpredictable films, it features an outstanding performance by Michael Keaton as the has-been star of a superhero franchise desperate to be taken seriously.
birdman-or-the-unexpected-virtue-of-igno.author: Claudia Puig

reviewedProduct.title: Birdman or (The Unexpected Virtue of Ignorance)

birdman-or-the-unexpected-virtue-of-igno.quote: Birdman takes advantage of every facet of Keaton’s talent, from his knack for absurdist comedy to his seemingly effortless ability to tap into graceful profundity without making a big show of it.
birdman-or-the-unexpected-virtue-of-igno.author: Rene Rodriguez

reviewedProduct.title: Birdman or (The Unexpected Virtue of Ignorance)

birdman-or-the-unexpected-virtue-of-igno.quote: Birdman—I should probably note here that the full title is the punctuationally ridiculous Birdman or (The Unexpected Virtue of Ignorance)—is a giddy fantasia of themes and genres, and if not all of them fully cohere, then so be it. As the Birdman voice inside Riggan’s head reminds us, sometimes viewers crave pure entertainment, not just “talky, pretentious, philosophical bullshit.”
birdman-or-the-unexpected-virtue-of-igno.author: Christopher Orr

reviewedProduct.title: Birdman or (The Unexpected Virtue of Ignorance)

birdman-or-the-unexpected-virtue-of-igno.quote: For Michael Keaton, Birdman is some kind of gift from the movie gods, a license to have his cake and messily devour it too.
birdman-or-the-unexpected-virtue-of-igno.author: A.A. Dowd

reviewedProduct.title: Birdman or (The Unexpected Virtue of Ignorance)

birdman-or-the-unexpected-virtue-of-igno.quote: Keaton reminds us what a fine actor he could always be.
birdman-or-the-unexpected-virtue-of-igno.author: Lawrence Toppman

reviewedProduct.title: Birdman or (The Unexpected Virtue of Ignorance)

birdman-or-the-unexpected-virtue-of-igno.quote: It’s undeniably thrilling to watch Gonzalez Iñárritu and Keaton aiming so high. Whenever they’re brave enough to leap into the unknown, Birdman soars.
birdman-or-the-unexpected-virtue-of-igno.author: Elizabeth Weitzman

reviewedProduct.title: Birdman or (The Unexpected Virtue of Ignorance)

birdman-or-the-unexpected-virtue-of-igno.quote: This is no tale told by an idiot — on the contrary, it’s a funny, fast-moving parable about fame and ambition, laid out for us with care and craft by a gifted filmmaker, a long-missed actor, and a world-class cinematographer. But I’m left with the suspicion the whole thing may signify — well, if not nothing, at least a good deal less than the filmmakers would have us believe.
birdman-or-the-unexpected-virtue-of-igno.author: Dana Stevens

reviewedProduct.title: Birdman or (The Unexpected Virtue of Ignorance)

birdman-or-the-unexpected-virtue-of-igno.quote: The movie is punctuated by comedy that at times verges on slapstick but there's an underlying anger in evidence - anger at the popular mindset that allows movies like "Transformers" to flourish while artistic endeavors fail.
birdman-or-the-unexpected-virtue-of-igno.author: James Berardinelli

reviewedProduct.title: Birdman or (The Unexpected Virtue of Ignorance)

birdman-or-the-unexpected-virtue-of-igno.quote: Birdman proves that a movie — the grabbiest, most kinetic film ever made about putting on a play — can soar on the wings of its own technical prowess, even as the banality of its ideas threatens to drag it back down to earth.
birdman-or-the-unexpected-virtue-of-igno.author: Michael Phillips

reviewedProduct.title: Birdman or (The Unexpected Virtue of Ignorance)

birdman-or-the-unexpected-virtue-of-igno.quote: Yes, at its best, Birdman soars, swoops and flutters with life and invention, but it parrots more than it speaks. You long for a writer as reliably, elegantly witty as Tom Stoppard, whose dramas are typically “backstage,” or if not Stoppard, at least a verbal speed-puncher like Armando Iannucci, or if not Iannucci, someone as relentlessly inventive and obsessive as Charlie Kaufman to make you feel like somebody is trying to say something, rather than a writing team filling in the intelligent-sounding words to support the boisterous performances and the virtuosic camera dance.
birdman-or-the-unexpected-virtue-of-igno.author: Liam Lacey

reviewedProduct.title: Birdman or (The Unexpected Virtue of Ignorance)

birdman-or-the-unexpected-virtue-of-igno.quote: Birdman is a marvelously entertaining picture, a work of "look at me!" bravado that's energized every minute. Its proficiency, the mechanically fluid kind, works against it in some ways.
birdman-or-the-unexpected-virtue-of-igno.author: Stephanie Zacharek

reviewedProduct.title: Birdman or (The Unexpected Virtue of Ignorance)

birdman-or-the-unexpected-virtue-of-igno.quote: This is not a film in need of creativity, passion or energy; what it needed was restraint, consideration and direction. This is not saying that Birdman is awful, or a debacle; there are superb scenes here, as well as excellent performance moments, but they get drowned out in the flood of Iñárritu’s ambition, energy and fantasies.
birdman-or-the-unexpected-virtue-of-igno.author: James Rocchi

reviewedProduct.title: Birdman or (The Unexpected Virtue of Ignorance)

birdman-or-the-unexpected-virtue-of-igno.quote: There’s no doubt it makes for a jubilant ride, a galvanic first blast. But it remains a film which feels deeply thought rather than deeply felt; a brilliant technical exercise as opposed to a flesh-and-blood story.
birdman-or-the-unexpected-virtue-of-igno.author: Xan Brooks

reviewedProduct.title: Birdman or (The Unexpected Virtue of Ignorance)

birdman-or-the-unexpected-virtue-of-igno.quote: Birdman is the very definition of a tour de force, and Iñárritu’s overheated technique meshes perfectly with the (enjoyable) overacting—the performers know this is a theatrical exercise and obviously relish the chance to Do It Big. But what comes out of the characters’ mouths is not so fresh.
birdman-or-the-unexpected-virtue-of-igno.author: David Edelstein

reviewedProduct.title: Birdman or (The Unexpected Virtue of Ignorance)

birdman-or-the-unexpected-virtue-of-igno.quote: A movie with ambitions as high-flying as its superhero but a success rate decidedly lower to the ground.
birdman-or-the-unexpected-virtue-of-igno.author: Peter Rainer

reviewedProduct.title: Birdman or (The Unexpected Virtue of Ignorance)

birdman-or-the-unexpected-virtue-of-igno.quote: It places regurgitated ideas into the mouths of gifted actors, then drops them amid a kooky story that plays like an elaborate distraction from what little the film actually has to say.
birdman-or-the-unexpected-virtue-of-igno.author: R. Kurt Osenlund

reviewedProduct.title: Birdman or (The Unexpected Virtue of Ignorance)

birdman-or-the-unexpected-virtue-of-igno.quote: Birdman trades on facile, casual dichotomies of theatre versus cinema and art versus commerce. It’s a white elephant of a movie that conceals a mouse of timid wisdom, a mighty and churning machine of virtuosity that delivers a work of utterly familiar and unoriginal drama.
birdman-or-the-unexpected-virtue-of-igno.author: Richard Brody

reviewedProduct.title: Birdman or (The Unexpected Virtue of Ignorance)

birdman-or-the-unexpected-virtue-of-igno.quote: Alejandro González Iñárritu is a pretentious fraud, but it’s taken some time to understand the precise nature of his fraudulence.
birdman-or-the-unexpected-virtue-of-igno.author: Scott Tobias

reviewedProduct.title: Birdman or (The Unexpected Virtue of Ignorance)

birdman-or-the-unexpected-virtue-of-igno.quote: An unrecognizable Michael Keaton seems to have aged 40 years since the last time he appeared on the screen, but he’s still the best (i.e., only) reason to suffer through a miserable load of deranged, deluded crap masquerading as a black comedy called Birdman.
birdman-or-the-unexpected-virtue-of-igno.author: Rex Reed

reviewedProduct.title: Birdman or (The Unexpected Virtue of Ignorance)

bardo-false-chronicle-of-a-handful-of-tr.quote: Throughout the film’s warranted nearly-three-hour runtime, Iñárritu writes the cinematic verses of an oneiric love poem to an ever-incongruous homeland while simultaneously investigating his own perceived hubris, insecurities and fractured identity.
bardo-false-chronicle-of-a-handful-of-tr.author: Carlos Aguilar

reviewedProduct.title: Bardo, False Chronicle of a Handful of Truths

bardo-false-chronicle-of-a-handful-of-tr.quote: It’s high minded stuff, but Iñárritu, has a knack for wrapping these ideas in movies that are well crafted and exciting to watch.
bardo-false-chronicle-of-a-handful-of-tr.author: Karen Gordon

reviewedProduct.title: Bardo, False Chronicle of a Handful of Truths

bardo-false-chronicle-of-a-handful-of-tr.quote: A deeply moving cinematic experience that entangles threads of Mexican history with one man’s surreal odyssey through life, death, success and grief.
bardo-false-chronicle-of-a-handful-of-tr.author: Kathy Michelle Chacón

reviewedProduct.title: Bardo, False Chronicle of a Handful of Truths

bardo-false-chronicle-of-a-handful-of-tr.quote: What interactions are “real” and what is imagined or symbolic is left to us to sort through, or just to decide it does not matter. Each moment is presented to us with vibrance and wit.
bardo-false-chronicle-of-a-handful-of-tr.author: Nell Minow

reviewedProduct.title: Bardo, False Chronicle of a Handful of Truths

bardo-false-chronicle-of-a-handful-of-tr.quote: “Mexico for me is a state of mind,” Iñárritu has said, and Bardo is his own idiosyncratic vision of it. It is a handsomely produced creation in which the director has clearly exercised great control and his stamp is to be found on almost every credit.
bardo-false-chronicle-of-a-handful-of-tr.author: Deborah Young

reviewedProduct.title: Bardo, False Chronicle of a Handful of Truths

bardo-false-chronicle-of-a-handful-of-tr.quote: As an all-in-one viewing experience, Bardo is undeniably uneven, often maddening, and seems to have approximately 17 endings. Still, the movie is a marvel in its own way, dotted with pure cinephile delights and small unexpected pockets of profundity.
bardo-false-chronicle-of-a-handful-of-tr.author: Leah Greenblatt

reviewedProduct.title: Bardo, False Chronicle of a Handful of Truths

bardo-false-chronicle-of-a-handful-of-tr.quote: The brilliance of what Iñárritu does here is that, if you watch any scene in “Bardo” for 30 seconds, you will keep watching. But you have to be willing to give him those 30 seconds at the start of each scene. You have to work with him a little.
bardo-false-chronicle-of-a-handful-of-tr.author: Mick LaSalle

reviewedProduct.title: Bardo, False Chronicle of a Handful of Truths

bardo-false-chronicle-of-a-handful-of-tr.quote: It’s impossible to deny the strength of the startling array of thoughts and concepts which Inarritu has brought to life and, ultimately, brings together, although the impact is clearly diluted by his unwillingness to cut.
bardo-false-chronicle-of-a-handful-of-tr.author: Fionnuala Halligan

reviewedProduct.title: Bardo, False Chronicle of a Handful of Truths

bardo-false-chronicle-of-a-handful-of-tr.quote: It is an exercise in self-punishment disguised as self-aggrandisement, by a director powered by confident resignation and – for those unlucky enough to have experienced the gaping hole of yearning for home – it is entirely worth the self-indulgence.
bardo-false-chronicle-of-a-handful-of-tr.author: Rafaela Sales Ross

reviewedProduct.title: Bardo, False Chronicle of a Handful of Truths

bardo-false-chronicle-of-a-handful-of-tr.quote: When it’s all said and done—the technical marvels elucidated, the stylistic flare appreciated, the wide-eyed self-reflection given a fair shake in retaliation to the all-too-easy critique of self-indulgence—I can’t help but wince a little at the thought of a second watch. If it’ll be great to revisit certain sequences, the thought of stomaching all three hours again so soon is grueling.
bardo-false-chronicle-of-a-handful-of-tr.author: Luke Hicks

reviewedProduct.title: Bardo, False Chronicle of a Handful of Truths

bardo-false-chronicle-of-a-handful-of-tr.quote: Dense and laborious, Bardo sometimes feels like an endurance test. Its moments of visual brilliance carry it far. Just not far enough to become essential viewing
bardo-false-chronicle-of-a-handful-of-tr.author: Murtada Elfadl

reviewedProduct.title: Bardo, False Chronicle of a Handful of Truths

bardo-false-chronicle-of-a-handful-of-tr.quote: As with all of Iñárritu’s films, “Bardo” isn’t just deeply felt but impassioned to the max, with grand designs to not just plunge into his own soul but that of Mexico, too. For a filmmaker always pushing for more — including those titles that stretch on and on — “Bardo” is his most ambitious and indulgent film yet.
bardo-false-chronicle-of-a-handful-of-tr.author: Jake Coyle

reviewedProduct.title: Bardo, False Chronicle of a Handful of Truths

bardo-false-chronicle-of-a-handful-of-tr.quote: It is made with real panache – so much panache, in fact, that you can forgive much of the film’s outrageous narcissism. Iñárritu could, if he chose, tell us an equally painful but less grandiose and auto-mythic story about his own life – but he has exercised his prerogative as an artist and given us this confection instead. It is certainly spectacular.
bardo-false-chronicle-of-a-handful-of-tr.author: Peter Bradshaw

reviewedProduct.title: Bardo, False Chronicle of a Handful of Truths

bardo-false-chronicle-of-a-handful-of-tr.quote: Audiences’ staying power for this meandering existential exploration of personal, professional and national identity — as tragicomic as it is rueful — will vary, depending on their interest in the artist or their appetite for the film’s aesthetic beauty.
bardo-false-chronicle-of-a-handful-of-tr.author: David Rooney

reviewedProduct.title: Bardo, False Chronicle of a Handful of Truths

bardo-false-chronicle-of-a-handful-of-tr.quote: Though ambitious and visually stunning (gorgeous cracked deserts, beautiful beaches, houses filled with sand), it’s willfully elusive and unwieldy to the point of frustrating.
bardo-false-chronicle-of-a-handful-of-tr.author: Jane Crowther

reviewedProduct.title: Bardo, False Chronicle of a Handful of Truths

bardo-false-chronicle-of-a-handful-of-tr.quote: Bardo sees director Alejandro González Iñárritu looking at the man in the (hall of) mirrors; the result is visually sensational but sometimes lethally patience-testing.
bardo-false-chronicle-of-a-handful-of-tr.author: John Nugent

reviewedProduct.title: Bardo, False Chronicle of a Handful of Truths

bardo-false-chronicle-of-a-handful-of-tr.quote: The incomparable Daniel Giménez Cacho stars as Silverio Gama, giving an unforgettable performance that captures the intensity of the film’s concepts. While everything doesn’t always work in Bardo, Iñárritu takes his time painting a visually scrumptious tale even though it’s overly saturated with style over substance.
bardo-false-chronicle-of-a-handful-of-tr.author: Patrice Witherspoon

reviewedProduct.title: Bardo, False Chronicle of a Handful of Truths

bardo-false-chronicle-of-a-handful-of-tr.quote: The picture still meanders and drags, and sometimes Iñárritu’s lofty ideas come off like a hot-air balloon that deflates and gets stuck in the trees. You wish he could just move on with things already. And yet there are some magnificent visions in Bardo.
bardo-false-chronicle-of-a-handful-of-tr.author: Stephanie Zacharek

reviewedProduct.title: Bardo, False Chronicle of a Handful of Truths

bardo-false-chronicle-of-a-handful-of-tr.quote: For all of the visual treats on display and for the moving moments that are better left unspoiled, nobody thought to withhold this director’s greater indulgences. And that is a shame — because when ‘Bardo’ hits the softer note it strives for, it’s really something to behold.
bardo-false-chronicle-of-a-handful-of-tr.author: Jack King

reviewedProduct.title: Bardo, False Chronicle of a Handful of Truths

bardo-false-chronicle-of-a-handful-of-tr.quote: With “Bardo,” Iñárritu delivers a cartoonishly indulgent film about the fact that he makes cartoonishly indulgent films — a rootless epic about a rootless man who’s been unmoored by his own self-doubt.
bardo-false-chronicle-of-a-handful-of-tr.author: David Ehrlich

reviewedProduct.title: Bardo, False Chronicle of a Handful of Truths

bardo-false-chronicle-of-a-handful-of-tr.quote: A lot happens in Bardo, much of it surreal. Elaborate musical numbers, dream sequences, alternate histories, and chronological hiccups all factor into this sprawling, whimsical, personal film. But once the lights go up and the spell is broken, all that striking imagery ends up feeling remarkably empty.
bardo-false-chronicle-of-a-handful-of-tr.author: Katie Rife

reviewedProduct.title: Bardo, False Chronicle of a Handful of Truths

bardo-false-chronicle-of-a-handful-of-tr.quote: Iñárritu has always been heavy-handed but his attempt to be airier creates more areas to bloat. And it gets incredibly unwieldy at points.
bardo-false-chronicle-of-a-handful-of-tr.author: Brian Formo

reviewedProduct.title: Bardo, False Chronicle of a Handful of Truths

bardo-false-chronicle-of-a-handful-of-tr.quote: Bardo seems to be Iñárritu’s deeply personal — if hermetic — attempt to make sense of the conflicting and unresolved impulses that have animated his life and art over the past two decades, during which he’s gone from promising emerging filmmaker to Oscar-winning superstar.
bardo-false-chronicle-of-a-handful-of-tr.author: Ann Hornaday

reviewedProduct.title: Bardo, False Chronicle of a Handful of Truths

bardo-false-chronicle-of-a-handful-of-tr.quote: It’s as immersive as it is insufferable. There’s greatness packed in there, but the most lasting impression is how much time is spent trying to convince you of it.
bardo-false-chronicle-of-a-handful-of-tr.author: Trace Sauveur

reviewedProduct.title: Bardo, False Chronicle of a Handful of Truths

bardo-false-chronicle-of-a-handful-of-tr.quote: There are magical moments, and brilliant sequences tossed into this ensalada of a movie.
bardo-false-chronicle-of-a-handful-of-tr.author: Roger Moore

reviewedProduct.title: Bardo, False Chronicle of a Handful of Truths

bardo-false-chronicle-of-a-handful-of-tr.quote: Iñárritu has cooked up a personal epic of the most exhaustingly swaggery type, man-spread across three hours of screen time during which flashes of genuine, startling brilliance occasionally manage to push their way through the strenuously zany macho-visionary fug.
bardo-false-chronicle-of-a-handful-of-tr.author: Robbie Collin

reviewedProduct.title: Bardo, False Chronicle of a Handful of Truths

bardo-false-chronicle-of-a-handful-of-tr.quote: Iñárritu has a lot on his mind here, weighing the sins and graces of personal and public history, and attempting to atone for some of it. But as Bardo stretches on and on and on, the film narrows into something solipsistic and meta.
bardo-false-chronicle-of-a-handful-of-tr.author: Richard Lawson

reviewedProduct.title: Bardo, False Chronicle of a Handful of Truths

bardo-false-chronicle-of-a-handful-of-tr.quote: So why is “Bardo,” for all its skill, reach-for-the-stars aspiration, and majestic sweep, such a windy, confounding, and — okay, I’ll just say it — monotonous experience? The movie is full of good things, but it’s three hours long and mostly it’s full of itself.
bardo-false-chronicle-of-a-handful-of-tr.author: Owen Gleiberman

reviewedProduct.title: Bardo, False Chronicle of a Handful of Truths

bardo-false-chronicle-of-a-handful-of-tr.quote: Iñárritu has a flair for the cinematic, for bold and striking images, but he is not an experimental filmmaker. He doesn’t have that kind of deft touch, that willingness to throw ideas at the wall, see what sticks, and — most importantly — move on.
bardo-false-chronicle-of-a-handful-of-tr.author: Bilge Ebiri

reviewedProduct.title: Bardo, False Chronicle of a Handful of Truths

bardo-false-chronicle-of-a-handful-of-tr.quote: Iñárritu, rather than answering them or leaving them provocatively unanswered (either one would be fine), does what he seems to do with most of his stories and ideas nowadays: He flings them around, roughs them up and rearranges them into an imposing, finally insufferable monument to his own awesomeness.
bardo-false-chronicle-of-a-handful-of-tr.author: Justin Chang

reviewedProduct.title: Bardo, False Chronicle of a Handful of Truths

bardo-false-chronicle-of-a-handful-of-tr.quote: As the film floats on, drifting from one extravagantly engineered reverie to another, the filmmaker only occasionally succeeds in making the audience feel his sorrow, regret and alienation. More often, his flights of fancy are merely exasperating.
bardo-false-chronicle-of-a-handful-of-tr.author: Kyle Smith

reviewedProduct.title: Bardo, False Chronicle of a Handful of Truths

bardo-false-chronicle-of-a-handful-of-tr.quote: Bardo speaks the language of dreams, but it also speaks the language of explaining those dreams in the most boring and literal ways.
bardo-false-chronicle-of-a-handful-of-tr.author: Siddhant Adlakha

reviewedProduct.title: Bardo, False Chronicle of a Handful of Truths

bardo-false-chronicle-of-a-handful-of-tr.quote: Named for a Buddhist concept referencing the transition between birth and death, Bardo may transport the viewer to a dream space but not perhaps the one Iñárritu intended. Zzzzz.
bardo-false-chronicle-of-a-handful-of-tr.author: Tara Brady

reviewedProduct.title: Bardo, False Chronicle of a Handful of Truths

bardo-false-chronicle-of-a-handful-of-tr.quote: It is, very occasionally, brilliant: a deft reveal in the final 20 minutes ties together the disparate, seemingly unrelated scenes that came before. But with its overuse of fish-eye lenses and the quacking, whimsical brass-heavy score, it’s extremely hard work.
bardo-false-chronicle-of-a-handful-of-tr.author: Wendy Ide

reviewedProduct.title: Bardo, False Chronicle of a Handful of Truths

bardo-false-chronicle-of-a-handful-of-tr.quote: Even when the maximalist visuals grab hold – as in, by your collar with an unpleasant yank – it is hard to feel much but exhaustion.
bardo-false-chronicle-of-a-handful-of-tr.author: Barry Hertz

reviewedProduct.title: Bardo, False Chronicle of a Handful of Truths

bardo-false-chronicle-of-a-handful-of-tr.quote: The film signals that Alejandro G. Iñárritu, perhaps, is unable to push the limits of his own artistic expression.
bardo-false-chronicle-of-a-handful-of-tr.author: Derek Smith

reviewedProduct.title: Bardo, False Chronicle of a Handful of Truths

bardo-false-chronicle-of-a-handful-of-tr.quote: Whether talking to himself or talking at his audience as if delivering wisdom deserving of an inscription on stone tablets, Iñárritu has nothing new or interesting to say. He's established he can move a camera with astonishing fluidity as well as blur fantasy and reality seamlessly. Now what? "Bardo" is a film high on its own supply yet low on any sense of actual intrigue or intuition.
bardo-false-chronicle-of-a-handful-of-tr.author: Marshall Shaffer

reviewedProduct.title: Bardo, False Chronicle of a Handful of Truths

the-revenant-2015.quote: Pushing both brutal realism and extravagant visual poetry to the edges of what one customarily finds in mainstream American filmmaking, director/co-writer Alejandro G. Inarritu, cinematographer Emmanuel Lubezki and a vast team of visual effects wizards have created a sensationally vivid and visceral portrait of human endurance under very nearly intolerable conditions.
the-revenant-2015.author: Todd McCarthy

the-revenant-2015.quote: Astounding. With a director, DoP and cast at the top of their game, The Revenant is a filmmaking triumph.
the-revenant-2015.author: James Mottram

the-revenant-2015.quote: What is so distinctive about this Iñárritu picture is its unitary control and its fluency: no matter how extended, the film’s tense story is under the director’s complete control and he unspools great meandering, bravura travelling shots to tell it: not dissimilar, in some ways, to his previous picture, Birdman. The movie is as thrilling and painful as a sheet of ice held to the skin.
the-revenant-2015.author: Peter Bradshaw

the-revenant-2015.quote: DiCaprio's raw performance helps elevate what could have been just another man-versus-nature drama.
the-revenant-2015.author: Nick de Semlyen

the-revenant-2015.quote: DiCaprio’s performance is an astonishing testament to his commitment to a role.
the-revenant-2015.author: Soren Andersen

the-revenant-2015.quote: A cold, visceral, and overwhelming piece of cinema.
the-revenant-2015.author: Michael Roffman

the-revenant-2015.quote: A riveting saga of pain, grit and the brute moral relativism of revenge, the first law of all, and the only one that mattered back then. The Revenant is one of the best pictures of the year.
the-revenant-2015.author: Roger Moore

the-revenant-2015.quote: The Revenant is a visceral sensation, filled with unforgettable visuals and memorable set pieces.
the-revenant-2015.author: Richard Roeper

the-revenant-2015.quote: The Revenant is an action blockbuster with an art house soul, a headlong rush of motion with meaning. Pure cinema from Iñárritu and Lubezki, two undisputed masters working at their peaks.
the-revenant-2015.author: Steve Persall

the-revenant-2015.quote: Boldly original, The Revenant puts everything else playing at the multiplexes in the shade.
the-revenant-2015.author: Calvin Wilson

the-revenant-2015.quote: The Revenant is every bit as technically proficient as Inarritu's "Birdman," a film that made critics swoon with its masterful handling of the filmmaker's daring "one-take" conceit. It manages, however, to do it without the same gimmicky feel.
the-revenant-2015.author: Mike Scott

the-revenant-2015.quote: Is the relentlessness too much? At two and a half hours, perhaps, but inventiveness abounds.
the-revenant-2015.author: Robert Abele

the-revenant-2015.quote: It is as impressive as any movie released this year, but the storytelling falters in some fundamental ways that keep me from completely adoring it. Innaritu dreams big, and he has the muscle to back it up. The Revenant may not be his best film yet, but it's hard to imagine many filmmakers who are working at a higher level than he is these days.
the-revenant-2015.author: Drew McWeeny

the-revenant-2015.quote: If you can work up interest in such meager material, the film is a chilling, stirring, experiential immersion in what life-and-death drama might actually feel like.
the-revenant-2015.author: Alan Scherstuhl

the-revenant-2015.quote: What elevates this standard, if relentless, plot line is that The Revenant feels like high-wire work without a net.
the-revenant-2015.author: Bob Mondello

the-revenant-2015.quote: Our favorite films often drop questions like these into our lives, allowing us to appreciate the world a little differently than before we saw them. The Revenant has this power. It lingers. It hangs in the back of your mind like the best classic parables of man vs. nature. It will stay there for quite some time.
the-revenant-2015.author: Brian Tallerico

the-revenant-2015.quote: The Revenant is the most intense thing you’ll enjoy over the holidays this side of family dinners.
the-revenant-2015.author: Brian Truitt

the-revenant-2015.quote: You could gripe about the excess of carnage and lack of philosophical substance. But surviving nature is Iñárritu's subject, and he delivers with magisterial brilliance.
the-revenant-2015.author: Peter Travers

the-revenant-2015.quote: In a year when no fewer than five films have dealt with themes of man vs. nature and survival (including The Martian, Everest, In the Heart of the Sea, and A Walk in the Woods), The Revenant is by far the most brutal, challenging, and astounding of these.
the-revenant-2015.author: James Berardinelli

the-revenant-2015.quote: The fact that the last line of dialogue is spoken five minutes before the end credits roll is telling: Words matter little in a movie that favors seeing and feeling above all else. It’s a work of pure, furious sensation.
the-revenant-2015.author: Rene Rodriguez

the-revenant-2015.quote: The Revenant is exhilarating cinema.
the-revenant-2015.author: Steven Rea

the-revenant-2015.quote: Though it may feel threadbare for some, Iñárritu’s near exhausting movie is still unforgettably visceral and there’s so much to be dazzled and experientially shaken by.
the-revenant-2015.author: Rodrigo Perez

the-revenant-2015.quote: What makes this more than just a punishing, fearful, expertly crafted thriller focused on one man’s endurance is heavily down to Emmanuel Lubezki’s attractive, thoughtful photography.
the-revenant-2015.author: Dave Calhoun

the-revenant-2015.quote: This brutal survival tale is so powerfully engrossing that, despite the clear limitations of his monochromatic, showy approach, the film’s compelling construction tends to override the legitimate criticisms.
the-revenant-2015.author: Tim Grierson

the-revenant-2015.quote: I’m not sure The Revenant is quite as tough and uncompromising as it thinks it is: it's coffee-table existentialism, with psychological brush-strokes so thick they might as well have been put on with a mop. But there’s no question it’s an extraordinary, blood-summoning, sinew-stiffening ride.
the-revenant-2015.author: Robbie Collin

the-revenant-2015.quote: While the style may outpace the substance, that doesn't make the style any less magnificent. And when it comes to sheer customer satisfaction, The Revenant checks nearly every box, up to and including the man vs. wild throwdown. It just makes a jarring, memorable statement about how often the wild is likely to win that uneven fight.
the-revenant-2015.author: Tasha Robinson

the-revenant-2015.quote: That grim realism sometimes makes The Revenant about as appetizing as a three-course meal of turkey jerky — but also serious enough to remind you of classics like "Jeremiah Johnson" and "Little Big Man." It's a gruesome adventure story that rarely lets up.
the-revenant-2015.author: Stephen Whitty

the-revenant-2015.quote: The combined exceptional work of star Leonardo DiCaprio and nonpareil cinematographer Emmanuel Lubezki create so much verisimilitude and beauty that it compels us to pay more attention to this glimpse of a dark, unsettling kill-or-be-killed world.
the-revenant-2015.author: Kenneth Turan

the-revenant-2015.quote: Mr. Iñárritu isn’t content to merely seduce you with ecstatic beauty and annihilating terror; he wants to blow your mind, to amp up your art-house experience with blockbusterlike awesomeness.
the-revenant-2015.author: Manohla Dargis

the-revenant-2015.quote: The most punishing movie of 2015, The Revenant, is almost as brutal an experience for the viewer to watch as it is for its title character Hugh Glass (DiCaprio) to undergo. That’s not meant as a knock, but rather as a warning that the film may leave you as near-speechless and mono-minded as its battered returnee from the dead.
the-revenant-2015.author: Marjorie Baumgarten

the-revenant-2015.quote: No amount of ingenious camerawork and breakneck pacing can obscure a simplistic core.
the-revenant-2015.author: Eric Kohn

the-revenant-2015.quote: Gorgeously shot by cinematographer Emmanuel Lubezki, Iñárritu’s savage endurance test of a film almost works better as a series of stunning images and surreal sequences than as an emotionally satisfying story.
the-revenant-2015.author: Chris Nashawaty

the-revenant-2015.quote: There’s a sense that the whole doesn’t quite equal the sum of the parts, no matter how spectacular some of them are.
the-revenant-2015.author: A.A. Dowd

the-revenant-2015.quote: A film I admired, but didn’t especially like, The Revenant is a master class in craftsmanship, marrying the ethos of 1970s Hollywood, with its beaten-dog heroes forever roughed up by a brutal system, to the technological prowess of today’s digitally obsessed blockbusters.
the-revenant-2015.author: Kyle Smith

the-revenant-2015.quote: I might be tempted to vote DiCaprio best actor — or at least to propose a new category be inaugurated, the acting equivalent of the Purple Heart.
the-revenant-2015.author: Mick LaSalle

the-revenant-2015.quote: Iñárritu has his eye so firmly on the myths of America that he loses sight of the men who made them. But he’s hardly the first person to do that.
the-revenant-2015.author: Ty Burr

the-revenant-2015.quote: The hitch with tales of endurance, onscreen, is their unfortunate habit of becoming endurance tests for the viewer, and, after a while, The Revenant turns into a slog. Make no mistake, it’s a very beautiful slog. Emmanuel Lubezki’s cinematography summons a wealth of wonders.
the-revenant-2015.author: Anthony Lane

the-revenant-2015.quote: The Revenant is supposed to be relentless, though you may find it tiresome, the movie equivalent of tigers circling a tree so single-mindedly that they churn themselves into butter.
the-revenant-2015.author: Stephanie Zacharek

the-revenant-2015.quote: Its scale and ambition at times makes it seem like more than it is: a survival story. There’s nothing wrong with that, and it’s a good one. It’s just not a whole lot more.
the-revenant-2015.author: Bill Goodykoontz

the-revenant-2015.quote: What The Revenant attempts but fails to do is create a larger vision from all this survivalist mayhem. It’s a useful how-to guide for how to stay alive after a bear attack – or a human attack, for that matter – but it doesn’t soar. It crawls.
the-revenant-2015.author: Peter Rainer

the-revenant-2015.quote: That first hour is big, and imposing. The rest grows smaller, with the script's self-conscious deeper meanings either layered on top, like pelts, or — more successfully — left to Luzbeki's meticulous images of a sun-dappled 19th century Eden now home to one too many Wal-Mart stores.
the-revenant-2015.author: Michael Phillips

the-revenant-2015.quote: In aiming to steer his dark, fatalistic vision toward something genuinely contemplative and cathartic, Inarritu has managed to appropriate the beauty of Malick’s filmmaking but none of its sublimity — another word for which might be humility. There is plenty of amazement here, to be sure, but all too little in the way of grace.
the-revenant-2015.author: Justin Chang

the-revenant-2015.quote: I think The Revenant is, on the whole, pain without gain, but it’s certainly a tour ​de force — literally, a feat of strength.
the-revenant-2015.author: David Edelstein

the-revenant-2015.quote: Though there's an awful lot to be admired - not least an enormously impressive soundscape - The Revenant ultimately lacks the nerve-jangling thrills or the spiritual resonance that it strives for.
the-revenant-2015.author: Ben Nicholson

the-revenant-2015.quote: If Iñárritu wanted to show how life on the frontier was miserable and monotonous he succeeded — by making a movie that is miserable and monotonous. Some of the greatest cinematography in history can’t change that fact.
the-revenant-2015.author: Matt Singer

the-revenant-2015.quote: Despite the literal and figurative pains it takes to persuade viewers of its own importance, The Revenant can’t escape the clutches of crippling self-regard.
the-revenant-2015.url: Its scale and ambition at times makes it seem like more than it is: a survival story. There’s nothing wrong with that, and it’s a good one. It’s just not a whole lot more.
the-revenant-2015.author: Ann Hornaday

the-revenant-2015.quote: However good DiCaprio may be, everything else feels overblown.
the-revenant-2015.author: Lawrence Toppman

the-revenant-2015.quote: For a while, at least, this one feels like Iñárritu’s masterpiece, until that familiar too-muchness begins to take over.
the-revenant-2015.author: Andrew O'Hehir

the-revenant-2015.quote: I came out of this would-be epic feeling physically exhausted, psychically mauled and none the better for wear.
the-revenant-2015.author: Joe Morgenstern

the-revenant-2015.quote: What pushes the film, at long last, into the icy river, is its very design, as a monument to slick, mercenary grandeur.
