mission-impossible-the-final-reckoning.quote: Running in the footsteps of the last two entries directed by Christopher McQuarrie, “Fallout” and “Dead Reckoning,” No. 8 is another high-voltage, gargantuanly envisioned test of Cruise’s bodily limits. Only this franchise can make wincing fun.
mission-impossible-the-final-reckoning.author: Johnny Oleksinski

mission-impossible-the-final-reckoning.quote: While it trades sprawling vistas for tighter set pieces, it brings Ethan Hunt’s story full circle in a way that’s surprisingly emotional and—dare I say it—earned.
mission-impossible-the-final-reckoning.author: Alan Ng

mission-impossible-the-final-reckoning.quote: While fans of the Mission: Impossible franchise might shed a tear watching this emotional tribute, all audiences will be swept away by its action.
mission-impossible-the-final-reckoning.author: Mary Kassel

mission-impossible-the-final-reckoning.quote: A tense, knotty opening act yields to some of Tom Cruise’s most impressive stunts yet, ending the film — and perhaps the series — on a high.
mission-impossible-the-final-reckoning.author: John Nugent

mission-impossible-the-final-reckoning.quote: The Final Reckoning is stuffed, convoluted, and ludicrous at times. But it’s also mostly a great send-off to this universe, a deserved celebration for everything this series has accomplished, and one final (again, seemingly) showcase for Cruise as one of the greatest action stars of all time.
mission-impossible-the-final-reckoning.author: Ross Bonaime

mission-impossible-the-final-reckoning.quote: The Final Reckoning, final or not, presents us with a fascinating contradiction: Ethan Hunt is both a pure singular and a state of mind. He’s cinema as the madman dreamer’s paradise.
mission-impossible-the-final-reckoning.author: Clarisse Loughrey

mission-impossible-the-final-reckoning.quote: In The Final Reckoning, Tom Cruise is out to save movies as much as Ethan Hunt is out to save the world.
mission-impossible-the-final-reckoning.author: Owen Gleiberman

mission-impossible-the-final-reckoning.quote: And then, saving the best till last, literally (of the entire franchise), there’s a helter-skelter biplane chase along South Africa’s Blyde River Canyon that’s simply one of the most extraordinary and apparently death-defying stunt set-pieces that anyone, let alone an A-list megastar, has ever attempted to put on film. And for this, Tom Cruise, we salute you. Mission accomplished.
mission-impossible-the-final-reckoning.author: Kevin Maher

mission-impossible-the-final-reckoning.quote: So, sure, the plot is overstuffed, the cross-cutting is frenzied, and Pegg’s goofy asides are the only light relief from the underlying somberness. If you’re looking for flaws, The Final Reckoning definitely has them. But with action sequences this adrenalised, no one is leaving short-changed.
mission-impossible-the-final-reckoning.author: Phil de Semlyen

mission-impossible-the-final-reckoning.quote: There’s ultimately lots to love about Final Reckoning and if this is the end, Cruise and Co are finishing on a high. It’s just a shame it takes so long to get going.
mission-impossible-the-final-reckoning.author: Lou Thomas

mission-impossible-the-final-reckoning.quote: For those of us who come to these movies wondering what Tom Cruise will be climbing, clinging onto, or falling off of, this sequel delivers the goods.
mission-impossible-the-final-reckoning.author: Alonso Duralde

mission-impossible-the-final-reckoning.quote: But even for a highly satisfied 30-year fan of Mission: Impossible as a Hollywood institution, this adventure is a little exhausting, and leaves Cruise looking ready to move on to the next world, even if he refuses to admit as much on screen. He’s a great actor and peerless movie star. Maybe it’s time to find another mask to put back on.
mission-impossible-the-final-reckoning.author: Jesse Hassenger

mission-impossible-the-final-reckoning.quote: Once Cruise and McQuarrie expunge all the Ozymandias from their systems, The Final Reckoning manages to deliver the goods. Or at least make a decent case that Cruise has earned the right to become his own biggest champion.
mission-impossible-the-final-reckoning.author: Barry Hertz

mission-impossible-the-final-reckoning.quote: The Final Reckoning‘s sum is not necessarily equal to its parts, but where the film stumbles technically, it soars viscerally, bolstered by the simple comfort that it’s just nice to hang with our friends in the IMF (even if they are stressed beyond measure).
mission-impossible-the-final-reckoning.author: Conor O'Donnell

mission-impossible-the-final-reckoning.quote: The film is a showcase for preposterous (and mostly practical) action and an unabashed sentimentality that Ethan feels for the makeshift family of spies he’s assembled over the course of the series.
mission-impossible-the-final-reckoning.author: Jake Cole

mission-impossible-the-final-reckoning.quote: If this is the end of the 'Mission: Impossible' movies, they ended on an adequate note.
mission-impossible-the-final-reckoning.author: William Bibbiani

mission-impossible-the-final-reckoning.quote: Somehow, The Final Reckoning is 170 minutes, but, like Tom Cruise running across Westminster Bridge, it zooms. Even the acres of baffling dialogue are delivered swiftly.
mission-impossible-the-final-reckoning.author: Jordan Hoffman

mission-impossible-the-final-reckoning.quote: When it kicks into gear in its second half, it provides the over-the-top thrills that fans have come to expect, and which are guaranteed to leave their hearts in their throats.
mission-impossible-the-final-reckoning.author: Nick Schager

mission-impossible-the-final-reckoning.quote: The eighth entry in the movie franchise that began in 1996 (based on a television series that began in 1966), is a competent, smart, expensive and sometimes thrilling action movie; it is also a very long one, in which we are given time to wonder whether spy/superhero/very intense runner Ethan Hunt (Cruise) ever just gets up in the morning and decides to take it easy that day.
mission-impossible-the-final-reckoning.author: Moira Macdonald

mission-impossible-the-final-reckoning.quote: ‘Final Reckoning’ might not be the perfect note to end this elaborate action symphony on, but as a sustained chord of passionate peril, intrigue, friendship and the wrenching expenses of keeping the world safe, hell, you could still do a lot worse.
mission-impossible-the-final-reckoning.author: Rodrigo Perez

mission-impossible-the-final-reckoning.quote: Once “M:I-TFR” kicks into action mode, the film becomes riveting as we await whatever crazy stunt Tom Cruise is going to spring on us.
mission-impossible-the-final-reckoning.author: Odie Henderson

mission-impossible-the-final-reckoning.quote: The climax of “Final Reckoning” is likewise impressive and scenic, but paced and edited less for the good of the overall movie and more for risk-verification purposes. That said, this franchise has class.
mission-impossible-the-final-reckoning.author: Michael Phillips

mission-impossible-the-final-reckoning.quote: It’s a no-holds-barred action-oriented epic that doesn’t much care if it makes sense as long as viewers are amped-up and engaged. When the end credits roar onto screen with a full-throated rendition of Lalo Schifrin’s iconic theme song, it’s hard to argue that a good time wasn’t had by all, even if that “time” lasts longer than necessary.
mission-impossible-the-final-reckoning.author: James Berardinelli

mission-impossible-the-final-reckoning.quote: The Final Reckoning stays true to those core tenets, even if it too often feels baggy and redundant. It’s a nesting doll of life-and-death deadlines within life-and-death deadlines, with one wildly improbable stunt leading to another, even more wildly improbable stunt.
mission-impossible-the-final-reckoning.author: Ann Hornaday

mission-impossible-the-final-reckoning.quote: It’s fair to say that Final Reckoning delivers ever more thrills and spills, even though the links between the action are ever more frayed.
mission-impossible-the-final-reckoning.author: Fionnuala Halligan

mission-impossible-the-final-reckoning.quote: The Final Reckoning brings both the Dead Reckoning storyline and the franchise as a whole to a satisfying close. As ever, Cruise is in peak condition, front and centre amid some looney stuntwork. If only his antagonist Gabriel was a more worthy opponent.
mission-impossible-the-final-reckoning.author: James Mottram

mission-impossible-the-final-reckoning.quote: The good news is that Final Reckoning does eventually recover from the calamity of its first hour to give us an entertaining, if still messy, Mission: Impossible movie.
mission-impossible-the-final-reckoning.author: Bilge Ebiri

mission-impossible-the-final-reckoning.quote: "Final Reckoning” is flat-out ridiculous, but it’s a model example of blockbuster entertainment at its most highly polished, and I enjoyed it thoroughly, despite its clichés, extravagant violence and gung-ho militarism.
mission-impossible-the-final-reckoning.author: Manohla Dargis

mission-impossible-the-final-reckoning.quote: Accepting the wild ambition of Final Reckoning, embracing its maudlin amassing of all M:I lore into one turgid act of nostalgia, is the best way to enjoy it.
mission-impossible-the-final-reckoning.author: Richard Lawson

mission-impossible-the-final-reckoning.quote: There’s a sense that the makers of Mission: Impossible: The Final Reckoning are biting a thumb at the naysayers and playing the hits one more time, albeit with a little bit more focus on the previous feature installments.
mission-impossible-the-final-reckoning.author: David Jenkins

mission-impossible-the-final-reckoning.quote: Whether or not this one is really the last in the series, Final Reckoning is a noble exemplar of a dying breed: the big, dumb, fun action blockbuster with a bona fide movie star at its center, putting it all on the line—and hanging on for dear life—just to keep us at the edge of our theater seats.
mission-impossible-the-final-reckoning.author: Dana Stevens

mission-impossible-the-final-reckoning.quote: The Final Reckoning is a more successful movie than Dead Reckoning because while Dead Reckoning did have some set pieces that were genuinely fun (such as the car chase through Rome, or the final train sequence), Final Reckoning actually has an ending.
mission-impossible-the-final-reckoning.author: Liz Shannon Miller

mission-impossible-the-final-reckoning.quote: Sure, it gets repetitive, and as one of the most expensive productions in history (the reported budget was around $400 million), it inevitably smacks of an imperial industry in decadent decline. But somewhere into the nearly three-hour runtime, the movie passes that crucial point where a critic stops taking notes and decides to simply enjoy themselves. The end is nigh, and it’s mostly a good time.
mission-impossible-the-final-reckoning.author: Ignatiy Vishnevetsky

mission-impossible-the-final-reckoning.quote: It’s a remarkable, lore-filled pivot from what we’d been made to believe about our hero for the past two decades. Over time, he’s gone from cipher to human being, from an excellent showman in the art of espionage to a model of the ideal man. This sense of self-importance, however, is one that the series can’t quite sustain.
mission-impossible-the-final-reckoning.author: David Sims

mission-impossible-the-final-reckoning.quote: By taking itself so seriously, “Final Reckoning” loses the cheeky ingredient in the recipe. It’s less fun, and that’s truly disappointing for a series that has given us some of the most exhilarating setpieces in action history.
mission-impossible-the-final-reckoning.author: Brian Tallerico

mission-impossible-the-final-reckoning.quote: Saving the showstopper for last will certainly leave audiences exiting the theater on a happy high note. But it’s hard to shake the feeling that in attempting to tie everything together, “Mission: Impossible” lost the plot.
mission-impossible-the-final-reckoning.author: Lindsey Bahr

mission-impossible-the-final-reckoning.quote: If it’s going to be the last we see of one of the most consistently entertaining franchises to come out of Hollywood in the past few decades — a subject about which Cruise and McQuarrie have remained vague — it’s a disappointing farewell with a handful of high points courtesy of the indefatigable lead actor.
mission-impossible-the-final-reckoning.author: David Rooney

mission-impossible-the-final-reckoning.quote: The old masters of early movie stunts who Cruise and McQuarrie so obviously admire knew that sometimes simpler was better.
mission-impossible-the-final-reckoning.author: Matt Singer

mission-impossible-the-final-reckoning.quote: While its action is reliably thrilling and a few of its most exciting sequences are sure to hold up through the years, Mission: Impossible – The Final Reckoning tries to deal with no less than the end of every living thing on the planet – and suffers because of it. The somber tone and melodramatic dialogue miss the mark of what’s made this franchise so much fun for 30 years, but the door is left open for more impossible missions and the hope that this self-serious reckoning isn’t actually final.
mission-impossible-the-final-reckoning.author: Clint Gage

mission-impossible-the-final-reckoning.quote: Too murky. Too little access to the character’s face. It takes a long, long time for the film to redeem itself with the biplane stunt you’ve seen on the poster.
mission-impossible-the-final-reckoning.author: Donald Clarke

mission-impossible-the-final-reckoning.quote: Cruise is reason audiences will, and should, see Final Reckoning on a large and loud screen.
mission-impossible-the-final-reckoning.author: Amy Nicholson

mission-impossible-the-final-reckoning.quote: Mission: Impossible — Final Reckoning feels like a conclusion to 30 years worth of proving that yes, you still can conjure up a certain vintage strain of Hollywood magic. It also feels like the end of an era.
mission-impossible-the-final-reckoning.author: David Fear

mission-impossible-the-final-reckoning.quote: It’s big, extravagant, and at times very beautiful to look at. The story is the problem: packed with expository dialogue, it feels as if it were written to be digested in 10- or 15-minute bites.
mission-impossible-the-final-reckoning.author: Stephanie Zacharek

mission-impossible-the-final-reckoning.quote: A movie needn’t be a work of art—and "The Final Reckoning," the baggiest, least satisfying film of the McQuarrie quartet, falls well short of the mark.
mission-impossible-the-final-reckoning.author: Justin Chang

mission-impossible-the-final-reckoning.quote: What we do care about, and what “Final Reckoning” finally delivers on after an overly expository first hour, is watching Tom do stuff. Set pieces involving a sunken submarine and buzzing biplanes amply fulfill the franchise’s main selling point.
mission-impossible-the-final-reckoning.author: Peter Rainer

mission-impossible-the-final-reckoning.quote: And yet, The Final Reckoning is too messy, too awkward, too clumsy. It somehow feels overlong and inert even as it never slows down.
mission-impossible-the-final-reckoning.author: Chris Evangelista

mission-impossible-the-final-reckoning.quote: “We make our own destiny,” someone intones during the film’s closing voiceover, and by the end of Ethan Hunt’s story, it’s hard not to take those words to heart. I only wish that Cruise and McQuarrie had managed to make a better one.
mission-impossible-the-final-reckoning.author: David Ehrlich

mission-impossible-the-final-reckoning.quote: Too often, the self-serving mission of making Mr. Cruise look cool clashes with the audience-serving mission of making sense. The balance between vanity and sanity leans the wrong way.
mission-impossible-the-final-reckoning.author: Kyle Smith

mission-impossible-the-final-reckoning.quote: It aims to be a nostalgic send-off, but the execution is muddled, forgetting that nobody ever came to these movies for the plot so much as the spectacle its amateur stuntman star provided in droves.
mission-impossible-the-final-reckoning.author: Alistair Ryder

mission-impossible-the-final-reckoning.quote: Not to put too fine a point on this or anything, but Mission: Impossible - The Final Reckoning is an interminable slog.
mission-impossible-the-final-reckoning.author: Liz Braun

mission-impossible-the-final-reckoning.quote: It’s only a movie, of course, not one of the better ones in this sometimes entertaining but occasionally muddled franchise. Taken to heart as a movie of its moment, and not just experienced as “a ride,” it’s too bad they had to go out with a bummer.
mission-impossible-the-final-reckoning.author: Roger Moore

mission-impossible-the-final-reckoning.quote: It's just a shame that the series' farewell had to be so solemn – and so silly.
mission-impossible-the-final-reckoning.author: Nicholas Barber

mission-impossible-the-final-reckoning.quote: Mission: Impossible — The Final Reckoning fumbles its own legacy, largely by believing it had one in the first place. With apologies to Simon Pegg and Ving Rhames, this has never been a franchise powered by our emotional connections to its characters, much less any sort of overarching, thematically resonant narrative. The Final Reckoning belatedly attempts to conjure up such qualities, while skimping on what has always mattered most in the series: scintillating stunt work.
mission-impossible-the-final-reckoning.author: Josh Larsen

mission-impossible-the-final-reckoning.quote: Holy hell, having to sit through nearly three hours of M:I making like Ethan Hunt is the Messiah is not just exhausting: It’s a total misread of what makes these movies so fun. What a bummer.
mission-impossible-the-final-reckoning.author: Kimberley Jones
